_about: Jean Daillé (1594-1670), pastor of the Reformed church at Charenton: A Treatise on the Right Use of the Fathers in the Decision of Controversies existing at this day in Religion, translated (1651) and revised by Thomas Smith, re-edited with a preface by G. Jekyll (London, 1843). His expositions of Philippians and Colossians are on the william-jenkyn shelf, bound with Jenkyn's Jude. The translator is not claimed in `_translators`, as 'smith' is a common-word surname. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
